news.analysis: Cousins spent six years in Minnesota, where he threw for 23,265 yards and 171 touchdowns in 88 games with a passer rating of 101.2. He will reunite with an offense he knows, which increases the fantasy value for Minnesota pass catchers, particularly Justin Jefferson. Cousins remains fantasy relevant as a high-end QB2 with some low-end QB1 potential.
news.contents: Kirk Cousins and the Raiders are finalizing a deal to trade the QB to the Vikings. Reports say Minnesota is sending Las Vegas a third-round pick in the deal.

news.contents: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson is excited to have quarterback Kirk Cousins back with the organization. It has been a down year for Jefferson, who is currently averaging a career-low 56.1 receiving yards per game.
